reason: sharp is only loaded by the Next.js image optimiser under a Node server (next start). Production runs on Cloudflare Workers via OpenNext, which cannot load native modules and never executes sharp; the fixed sharp 0.35 changes its native-binary loading so the OpenNext bundle no longer builds. Re-check when Next/OpenNext support sharp >= 0.35.5.
